note: V4 era goals: 3 per era; real achievements at history's pace; rewards and setbacks are small and never end the game. Generated by progress/v4goals/gen_goals.py. v4 fix round (v4fix-sim, progress/v4fix_sim/goals_fix.py): g01 retitled and Readiness 58, g06 Readiness 63, g10 and g14 also need Standing at least 95% of history's, seven goals that every strategy met are marked "milestone", and the trust label is plainer.
metrics_note: metric ids: any SimEndgame.metric() id (readiness, standing, inflation, debt_years, treaties, town_strikes_ratio, min_group_trust, housing_shortfall, track_ratio:<track>, programme_levels:<group>) plus SimGoals': population, cities, avg_trust, project:<building id> (1 when built), programme_level:<programme id>, status:<actor id> with 'in' (1 when the status is in the list), crisis_over:<war id>

goals.title: Win the war and build the army
goals.text: Hold the towns through the 1948 war until the armistice agreements, and leave the new army ready: Readiness 58 or more.
goals.history: Israel signed armistice agreements with Egypt (24 Feb 1949), Lebanon (23 Mar), Jordan (3 Apr) and Syria (20 Jul 1949).

setback.label: A costly war
setback.desc: Civic Trust -1 for 4 quarters (a costly war)

goals.title: Absorb the mass immigration
goals.text: By mid-1957 settle the newcomers without social strain: no group of towns (Arab localities, development towns, the periphery) has lost faith in the state.
goals.history: About 690,000 immigrants arrived between 1948 and 1951; transit camps (ma'abarot) housed many of them through the 1950s.

all.label: Lowest Civic Trust of any group of towns

reward.label: Settled newcomers
reward.desc: Civic Trust +2 in development towns for 8 years

setback.label: The ma'abarot linger
setback.desc: Civic Trust -2 in development towns for 8 quarters

goals.title: Milestone: Found the development towns
goals.text: Spread the new population into new towns in the periphery.
goals.history: The Sharon Plan of 1951 set out new towns; Kiryat Gat followed in 1954, Dimona in 1955 and Ashdod in 1956.

setback.desc: No reward: the new towns stay on the map

goals.title: Milestone: Build the National Water Carrier
goals.text: Carry water from the Sea of Galilee to the Negev.
goals.history: The National Water Carrier began carrying water in June 1964.

setback.label: The pipeline is late
setback.desc: Water supply -15 million m3 a year for 8 quarters

goals.title: The growth years
goals.text: Grow faster than history did: by Q4 1965 the economy stands 3% above history's path.
goals.history: Israel's gross national product rose rapidly after 1948; the 1966 recession followed the growth years.

reward.label: A milder recession
reward.desc: Civic Trust +1 for 4 quarters (the 1966 recession is milder)

setback.label: The mitun bites
setback.desc: Civic Trust -2 for 4 quarters (the mitun, the 1966 recession)

goals.title: Ready for June 1967
goals.text: Have the army ready when the crisis of May-June 1967 comes: Readiness 63 or more.
goals.history: Egypt massed troops in Sinai in May 1967 and Israel mobilised; the war began on 5 June 1967.

reward.text: The reserves report in days, not weeks.

setback.label: Mobilisation in disorder
setback.desc: Readiness -3 for 4 quarters

goals.title: Hold the canal: the War of Attrition
goals.text: Get through the War of Attrition without more strikes on towns than history's.
goals.history: The War of Attrition along the Suez Canal ran from March 1969 to August 1970.

setback.label: Weary border towns
setback.desc: Civic Trust -1 in the periphery for 4 quarters

goals.title: Not surprised in October 1973
goals.text: Be ready for the attack before it comes. History itself fell short of this.
goals.history: Egypt and Syria attacked on 6 October 1973; the Agranat Commission later found the army was not adequately prepared.

reward.text: The attack is met on the first day.

setback.label: The post-war protest
setback.desc: Civic Trust -2 for 4 quarters (the post-war protest)

goals.title: Absorb the 1970s aliyah
goals.text: Welcome the immigrants of the early 1970s so well that Civic Trust across the country reaches 92 by early 1977.
goals.history: Between 38,000 and 56,000 immigrants a year arrived in 1969-73.

setback.label: Crowded cities
setback.desc: Civic Trust -1 in large cities for 4 quarters

goals.title: Peace with Egypt
goals.text: Make peace with Egypt, the largest neighbour, while Israel keeps its standing in the world (at least about history's).
goals.history: Camp David accords 17 Sep 1978; the peace treaty was signed on 26 Mar 1979; Sinai was returned on 25 Apr 1982.

reward.desc: Standing +3; Peace dividends level 1 costs 20% less

setback.label: No treaty with Egypt
setback.desc: Standing -2 for 8 quarters

goals.title: Defeat hyperinflation
goals.text: Bring yearly inflation under 10% by the end of 1987. History reached about 16%.
goals.history: Inflation ran near 450% a year in 1984; it fell under 20% within two years of the July 1985 stabilisation plan.

setback.label: Prices still rising
setback.desc: Civic Trust -2 for 4 quarters

goals.title: Leave Lebanon at a bearable cost
goals.text: Withdraw from Lebanon in 1985 without more strikes on towns than history's.
goals.history: The 1982 war ended for Israel with the June 1985 withdrawal; 654 Israelis had died.

setback.label: A war that lingers
setback.desc: Readiness -2 for 4 quarters

goals.title: Absorb a million
goals.text: Settle the immigration from the former Soviet Union: almost nobody is left without housing and the weakest group of towns keeps its Civic Trust at 82 or more.
goals.history: 906,500 immigrants arrived in 1990-2001, many into caravan sites in 1990-96.

all.label: Lowest Civic Trust of any group of towns

reward.desc: Science score +2% (the engineers of the aliyah)

setback.label: Crowded cities
setback.desc: Civic Trust -2 in large cities for 8 quarters

goals.title: Peace with Jordan
goals.text: Make peace with Jordan while Israel keeps its standing in the world (at least about history's).
goals.history: The Israel-Jordan peace treaty was signed on 26 Oct 1994.

setback.label: No treaty with Jordan
setback.desc: Standing -2 for 8 quarters

goals.title: Launch Yozma
goals.text: Start the state-backed venture capital programme that seeded the high-tech industry.
goals.history: Yozma, a government venture-capital programme, began in 1993.

reward.desc: Space and cyber levels 2-3 cost 15% less

setback.label: No venture capital
setback.desc: Science output -3% for 8 quarters

goals.title: Lead the world in R&D
goals.text: Put science well ahead of history's path: 25% above it by Q4 2007.
goals.history: Israel's research and development spending reached about 3.8% of GDP in 2000, among the highest in the world.

setback.label: Labs lose ground
setback.desc: Science output -3% for 8 quarters

goals.title: End the Second Intifada
goals.text: Come out of the Second Intifada, by early 2005, without more strikes on towns than history's.
goals.history: The Sharm el-Sheikh summit of 8 Feb 2005 ended four and a half years of violence.

setback.label: Scarred towns
setback.desc: Civic Trust -2 for 4 quarters

goals.title: Milestone: Desalinate at Ashkelon
goals.text: Open a large seawater desalination plant.
goals.history: The Ashkelon desalination plant began producing in August 2005.

setback.label: Drought years
setback.desc: Water supply -15 million m3 a year for 8 quarters

goals.title: Milestone: Iron Dome over the towns
goals.text: Put a missile shield over the towns.
goals.history: Iron Dome made its first interception on 7 Apr 2011.

reward.text: The sirens sound, the rockets fall short.

setback.label: Exposed towns
setback.desc: Civic Trust -1 in the periphery for 4 quarters

goals.title: Milestone: Bring Tamar gas ashore
goals.text: Bring the first offshore gas field into production.
goals.history: Gas from the Tamar field began to flow on 30 Mar 2013.

reward.desc: The gas fields level 2 costs 20% less

setback.label: Imported fuel
setback.desc: Treasury -1% of income for 8 quarters

goals.title: Milestone: Water from the sea
goals.text: Make desalination supply most of the drinking water.
goals.history: The Sorek plant opened in 2013; most of Israel's drinking water was desalinated by the mid-2010s.

setback.label: Thirsty summers
setback.desc: Water supply -15 million m3 a year for 8 quarters

goals.title: Normalise with the Gulf
goals.text: Sign normalisation with the United Arab Emirates.
goals.history: Israel and the UAE signed the Abraham Accords on 15 Sep 2020.

reward.desc: Standing +2; Peace dividends level 3 costs 20% less

setback.label: A closed door
setback.desc: Standing -2 for 8 quarters

goals.title: Vaccinate the nation
goals.text: Come through the 2020-21 pandemic more united than history did: cohesion 40% above history's path by Q2 2021.
goals.history: The vaccination drive began on 20 Dec 2020.

setback.label: A divided pandemic
setback.desc: Civic Trust -2 for 4 quarters

goals.title: Milestone: Plans for the Arab communities
goals.text: Fund the multi-year government plans for Arab communities.
goals.history: Government Resolution 922 (2015) launched the first five-year plan; the 2021 plan allocated NIS 32 billion.

reward.label: Plans that reach the towns
reward.desc: Civic Trust +2 in Arab localities for 8 years

setback.label: Unmet promises
setback.desc: Civic Trust -2 in Arab localities for 4 quarters
